name: Black Mountain Summit Walk
sourceTitle: Black Mountain Nature Reserve - Parks ACT
notes: Same page also gives 2.4km round trip plus 300m each way from the Frith Road substation (about 1.5km one way). Ours is 2.2km one way from near ANBG; compare with 2.7km one way (ANBG) or 1.5km one way (Frith Rd) depending on our start. Gain 220m is consistent with ANBG (~590m) to summit (812m).

name: Forest Loop Walk
sourceTitle: Black Mountain Nature Reserve - Parks ACT
notes: Page says 'return' but it is a loop walk; treat as total loop length.

name: Link walk
sourceTitle: Black Mountain Nature Reserve - Parks ACT
notes: Ours is mapped as a 2.68km loop; 'return' here likely means total walked distance.

name: Little Black Mountain Walk
sourceTitle: Black Mountain Nature Reserve - Parks ACT
notes: Lollipop: 1.4km approach + 2.4km circuit + 1.4km back. Ours is 3.38km 'one-way', i.e. approach plus circuit should be ~3.8km.

name: Black Mountain Woodland Walk
sourceTitle: Black Mountain Nature Reserve - Parks ACT

sourceTitle: Tracks and trails - National Arboretum Canberra

name: STEP Circuit
sourceTitle: Tracks and trails - National Arboretum Canberra

sourceTitle: Tracks and trails - National Arboretum Canberra

name: RG Menzies Walk
sourceTitle: R G Menzies Walk | VisitCanberra
notes: VisitCanberra (ACT Government tourism), not NCA; no NCA figure found. Commonwealth Avenue Bridge to Kings Avenue. Ours is 2.56km, so our mapped way may extend past Kings Avenue.

name: Shepherds Lookout Loop
sourceTitle: Explore Shepherd's Lookout - Parks ACT
notes: Lower confidence on the match: the official walk starts from McClymount Way, Ginninderry; ours (7.0km, starts near The Link, Strathnairn) looks like the same Ginninderry-to-lookout walk but the route may differ.

name: Light to Light Walk
sourceTitle: Light to Light walk | Visitor info | NSW National Parks
notes: Boyds Tower to Green Cape Lighthouse. Other NSW Government material quotes 30km (VisitNSW) and 34km (NSW Great Walks list).

name: Murramarang South Coast Walk
sourceTitle: Murramarang South Coast Walk | Visitor info | NSW National Parks
notes: Pretty Beach to Maloneys Beach. Ours 34.49km.

name: Snowies Alpine Walk
sourceTitle: Snowies Alpine Walk | Visitor info | NSW National Parks
notes: Guthega to Bullocks Flat over 4 days; some NPWS pages still say 55km. Ours is 44.4km, so the OSM relation is probably missing a section (e.g. the Main Range day or a link); check before using as a test case.

name: Gidjuum Gulganyi Walk
sourceTitle: Gidjuum Gulganyi Walk | Visitor info | NSW National Parks

sourceTitle: Yuraygir coastal walk | Visitor info | NSW National Parks

name: World Heritage Walk

name: The Coast Track
sourceTitle: The Coast Track | Visitor info | NSW National Parks

name: Main Range Walking Track
sourceTitle: Main Range walk | NSW National Parks

name: Kiama Coast Walk
sourceTitle: Kiama Coast Walk - Kiama Municipal Council

sourceTitle: Wharf to Wharf Walk | NSW Government
notes: Merimbula Wharf to Tathra Wharf. NSW Government tourism page, not a council or NPWS page. Ours 25.56km.

name: Wilderness Coast Walking Track
sourceTitle: Nadgee wilderness walk | NSW National Parks
notes: Lower confidence on the match: our relation is named for the Victorian Wilderness Coast Walk (100km in Croajingolong) but starts at Merrica River, so it looks like the Nadgee leg. Ours 48.65km may stop at the state border or Cape Howe rather than Mallacoota.
